settings.title: Settings
settings.developer_mode_hint: Unlocks developer-only fields such as the cloud-inference server URL. Leave this off unless you know exactly what you are doing — never turn it on because someone told you to.
settings.github_mirror_hint: How app updates and bot installs reach GitHub. Auto tries a direct connection first, then falls back to public accelerator mirrors — for regions where GitHub is blocked. (Chrome for Testing downloads always fall back to a public mirror automatically, regardless of this setting.)
settings.custom_mirror_hint: Optional gh-proxy-style accelerator, tried before the built-in list. Public mirrors come and go — set one that works in your region.
settings.custom_mirror_invalid: Must start with http:// or https://
settings.platform_game_hint: Selects which bridge parses the WebSocket protocol. Saving triggers a capture restart so the new bridge picks up the next session.
settings.capture_mode_hint: MITM proxy needs CA cert + system proxy. Chromium launches a controlled browser — no setup.
settings.capture_mitm_only: This platform has no web client — MITM capture only.
settings.block_telemetry_hint: Drop the game's Aliyun analytics beacons instead of forwarding them, so login stats and device / account identifiers never leave your machine. Many ad blockers already block this host, so a missing beacon is not a sign of a tool. On by default.
settings.ca_dir_hint: Where root certificate / keys are written.
settings.detect_status_initial: Click Detect to scan for installed browsers.
settings.user_data_dir_hint: Leave blank to use the default Akagi profile under your config dir.
settings.appearance_sidebar_hint: When the sidebar is collapsed, peek-on-hover expands it temporarily without pinning it open.
settings.ui_scale_hint: Scales typography, spacing, and controls across the app. Saved locally.
settings.custom_hint: Pick five base colors per mode — the rest of the palette is derived automatically via color-mix.
settings.custom_import_hint: Paste a tweakcn URL (share /themes/<id>, editor /editor/theme?theme=<name>, or registry /r/themes/<name>.json) or the raw JSON body. Overrides every token defined in the source.
settings.unsaved_desc: You have unsaved settings changes. Save them before leaving, discard them, or stay on this page.

autoplay.title: Autoplay
autoplay.enable_help: When enabled, Akagi performs the bot's chosen action for you. On Mahjong Soul and Tenhou it drives the client through the Chromium capture backend (a running game tab is required); on Riichi City it injects the client's own protocol frames through the MITM proxy (no Chromium needed).
autoplay.platform_note: These click-timing knobs apply to Mahjong Soul only. Tenhou and Riichi City autoplay send the action over the game connection and do not click, so they use the thinking-time model below but none of the settings above.
autoplay.requires_chromium: Autoplay requires the Chromium capture mode.
autoplay.rc_warning_desc: Autoplay on Riichi City is implemented by injecting protocol frames through the MITM proxy. This approach still has open safety concerns and may get your account banned. Use it at your own risk.
autoplay.hover_delay_hint: Mouse must hover for ≥100ms before mousedown for Mahjong Soul to register a tile click. Lower values risk dropped clicks.
autoplay.verify_input_hint: After clicking, wait this long for the game client to send its own input command. If nothing arrives the click was swallowed and is pressed again. 0 disables verification.
autoplay.click_retries_hint: How many times a swallowed click is pressed again. Retries hold the button longer (and nudge the cursor) instead of repeating the same press. 0 only logs.
autoplay.dealer_first_discard_extra_delay_hint: Mahjong Soul plays a hand-sort animation when the dealer is dealt all 14 tiles. Clicks during the animation are dropped. ~2000ms covers most devices.
autoplay.delay_mode_lua_help: Delays come from delay.lua next to the config file, generated with a human-like model calibrated against ranked-game data on first use. Edit it freely — it hot-reloads on save; delete it to restore the default. If the script errors, a built-in model takes over.
autoplay.min_delay_hint: Safety floor for every action: Mahjong Soul needs time to render the UI, and a click issued too early is silently lost. Applies in both modes and cannot be undercut by the script.
autoplay.min_button_delay_hint: Higher floor for chi/pon/kan/ron/skip/riichi buttons — they appear only after the discard animation plus their own pop-in, later than hand tiles. Raise this if buttons are still missing clicks.
autoplay.queue_fallback_sun: Find a Sun table after 2 minutes
autoplay.session_idle: Riichi City auto-queue: play N games back to back (leave empty for endless), with the next match queued automatically after each game.

settings.overlay_enabled_hint: A small always-on-top window that floats over the game and shows the bot's top suggestions. Drag it anywhere.
settings.overlay_always_on_top_hint: Turn this off to park the overlay on a second monitor. Note that a game running in exclusive fullscreen draws over every always-on-top window — use borderless or windowed mode.

welcome.title: Welcome to Akagi
welcome.body1: Akagi watches your mahjong game traffic and runs an mjai-protocol bot alongside it for realtime advice. Before the bot can do anything, Akagi needs a way to capture the game's WebSocket traffic.
welcome.body2: On the next page you'll pick between the legacy MITM proxy (powerful but requires CA-cert trust) and a controlled Chromium browser (no proxy / certificate setup — Akagi launches its own browser window).

platform.title: Pick your platform
platform.desc: Akagi listens for one game's WebSocket protocol at a time. You can change this later in Settings.

mode.title: Pick a capture mode
mode.chromium_desc: Akagi launches a controlled browser and intercepts WebSocket frames via Chrome DevTools Protocol. No system proxy. No CA cert. Works for Mahjong Soul and Tenhou; not for RiichiCity (no web client).
mode.mitm_desc: hudsucker-based MITM. You configure your system proxy and trust Akagi's self-signed CA. Required for RiichiCity (no web client).

mitm.title: MITM proxy settings
mitm.ca_dir_hint: The CA cert is generated on first start. Trust the .pem / .crt file in your OS or browser certificate store before pointing the game at this proxy.
mitm.proxy_enabled_hint: Master switch — leave on for Akagi to start the proxy automatically.

chromium.title: Chromium settings
chromium.exec_hint: Leave blank to auto-detect a system Chrome / Edge / Brave / Chromium.
chromium.warning_no_browser: No browser is available yet. Either install Chrome / Edge / Brave / Chromium on your system, enter an executable path above, or click Download to install Chrome for Testing.

bots.title: Install MJAI bots
bots.desc: An MJAI bot is required for game analysis — without one, Akagi only captures traffic. The author publishes pre-built Mortal-based bots for both 4-player and 3-player modes; install one or both here. Skip this step if you have your own bot.
bots.license_body: Akagi-MjaiBot-Mortal is distributed under {{license}}. By installing, you agree to its terms.
bots.install_note: Installation runs {{cmd}} on the bot's {{file}} and may take a few minutes on first run.

configure.title: Configure bots
configure.normal_desc: These knobs let you tweak bot behaviour. You can change them later under Bots → Configure.
configure.models_body: The Mortal weights bundled with this install are only there to verify that the install works — not recommended for real play. Stronger weights are available on the Discord server.

finish.title: All set
finish.click_finish_post: to save these settings. The capture backend will start automatically. You can change everything later in Settings → Capture, or rerun this wizard from there.

bots.title: Bots
bots.delete_desc_post: from the bots directory, including its installed files, virtualenv, and settings. This action cannot be undone.
bots.install_local_name: Local name (optional, defaults to repo name)
bots.install_zip_title: Install bot from a local ZIP file
bots.install_zip_path_hint: Pick a local .zip, or paste its full path.
bots.drawer_reinstall_tooltip: Wipe and recreate the Python virtualenv for this bot
bots.env_not_ready_tooltip: Environment not installed yet — install or sync it before activating.
bots.install_env_tooltip: Build the Python environment (uv sync) so this bot can be activated

api.title: Cloud inference (built-in bot)
api.desc: Optionally route the built-in bot's moves to MJOT, the online inference service, for a stronger model. The offline local model stays as an automatic fallback if the server is unreachable.
api.mjot_tagline: Online AI inference for the built-in bot
api.apply_immediately: Changes take effect immediately after saving, even during a game.
api.enable_hint: When on, the built-in bot asks the server for each move; it falls back to the local model on any error.
api.base_url_locked: The MJOT server URL is locked. Do not change it unless you know exactly what you are doing.
api.proxy_hint: Route all MJOT traffic — inference, key checks, redeem and purchase — through this proxy. Supports http://, https://, socks5:// and socks5h:// (socks5h resolves DNS through the proxy). Turn the switch off to connect directly.
api.proxy_invalid: Enter a valid proxy URL: http://, https://, socks5:// or socks5h://
api.react_timeout_hint: How long to wait for each move from the server before falling back to the offline local model. Higher tolerates a slow server; lower gives up sooner. Default 3000ms (clamped to 500–10000).
api.model_hint: Model id from the server. Leave empty to use the server's default.
api.models_empty: No models available for this key.
api.native_selected: Active bot switched to the built-in bot — MJOT cloud inference runs through it.
api.disabled_no_native: MJOT cloud inference turned off: the built-in bot is no longer active in any mode.
api.mode_not_native: MJOT cloud inference does not apply to {{mode}} anymore (another bot is active there); it still serves {{other}} through the built-in bot.
api.save_key_check_failed: Can't save with cloud inference on: the API key check failed. Fix the key or turn the API off.
api.need_url_key: Enter the server URL and API key first.
api.redeem_email_hint: Links keys to an account so they can be managed together. Leave blank to redeem anonymously.
api.redeem_renew: Add time to my current key
api.redeem_renew_hint: Stacks time onto the key saved above instead of minting a new one.
api.redeem_renew_active: The redeemed time will be added to your current key …{{last4}} (valid until {{until}}). Turn this off to mint a separate new key instead.
api.redeem_new_key: New {{plan}} key issued (…{{last4}}) and saved — you're ready to go.
api.buy_desc: Pay online and the key is filled in automatically. Every purchase is also emailed to you as a backup.
api.buy_price_note: Prices in USD, for reference — the exact amount is shown on the checkout page.
api.buy_provider_creem: Credit card · Google Pay · Apple Pay · Alipay
api.buy_switch_creem: Pay by card / Google Pay / Apple Pay / Alipay instead
api.buy_renew: Add the time to my current key
api.buy_renew_hint: Stacks the purchased days onto the key above instead of minting a new one (same plan only).
api.buy_renew_active: The purchased days will be added to your current key …{{last4}} (valid until {{until}}). Turn this off to get a separate new key instead.
api.buy_sub_hint: Renews automatically through {{provider}}; cancel anytime in your {{provider}} account — the key keeps working until the paid period ends.
api.buy_waiting: Waiting for payment — complete the checkout in your browser.
api.buy_waiting_hint: You can close this window; the purchase keeps running in the background. If the app closes before it finishes, the code/key also arrives by email.
api.buy_redeem_failed: Payment succeeded, but activating the code failed. The code below was not consumed — you can retry.
api.buy_done_key: New {{plan}} key issued (…{{last4}}) and filled in — you're ready to go.
api.buy_delivered: The purchase completed a while ago, so the code/key was emailed to you — check your inbox.
api.buy_fail_claim: The server rejected this purchase session. If you completed the payment, the code/key arrives by email.
api.buy_fail_timeout: The payment wasn't completed in time. If you did pay, the code/key arrives by email.
api.buy_chip_pending: Purchase in progress — click to view
api.buy_chip_action: Purchase needs attention — click to view

dialog.error_unsupported_platform: Auto-update is not available for your platform. Open the release page to download manually.
dialog.error_no_matching_asset: This release has no build for your platform yet.
dialog.error_digest_mismatch: Downloaded file doesn't match the release checksum. Try again or download manually.
dialog.error_signature_missing: This release is unsigned and the download would go through a mirror. Open the release page to update manually.
dialog.error_signature_invalid: Signature verification failed for the downloaded file. Refusing to install — try again or download manually.
